title: Relevant coordinates bounded by total influence
statement: Let $f:\{-1,1\}^n\to\mathbb R$, and let $a\in\mathbb R$. If every relevant coordinate has influence at least $a$, then $a$ times the number of relevant coordinates is at most the total influence of $f$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a real-valued function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube
